name: Fertility
about: Desire, the hormones that drive it and the reproductive axis, gonads and gametes, the cycle, fertilization and pregnancy. Built from Open Targets disease genetics and Gene Ontology, not from the library.
rule: Gene Ontology mechanism genes, plus Open Targets genes scoring ≥ 0.5 (≥ 0.8 genetic for level and timing traits)

mechanisms.name: Desire and sexual behaviour
mechanisms.about: Reproductive behaviour: mating, sexual and maternal behaviour.

mechanisms.name: Sex hormone production
mechanisms.about: Making testosterone, estradiol, progesterone and their precursors.

mechanisms.name: Reproductive axis signalling
mechanisms.about: GnRH, LH and FSH release and response, and steroid hormone receptor signalling.

mechanisms.name: Gonad and sex development
mechanisms.about: Building testes and ovaries and determining sex.

mechanisms.name: Ovarian cycle and ovulation
mechanisms.about: Follicle development, ovulation and the menstrual cycle.

mechanisms.name: Fertilization
mechanisms.about: Sperm meeting egg: capacitation, the acrosome reaction and binding.

mechanisms.name: Implantation and pregnancy
mechanisms.about: Implantation, decidualization, the placenta and birth.
